entities.name: Haudenosaunee (Iroquois)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Great Law of Peace united five (later six) nations — Mohawk, Seneca, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga, and Tuscarora — into the oldest participatory democracy on Earth. Clan mothers chose chiefs and could remove them.
